reason: The named lab and the batch report behind the QR code is more than most TikTok magnesium gives me, and $24.99 is an easy impulse buy if a creator's video hits my sleep problem. Pre-counted sachets and the money-back guarantee mean I can try one box without much risk.
objection: Why only one form of magnesium when other brands put 8 forms in one capsule? I would want to know bisglycinate alone is actually enough.
would_change_my_mind: A creator video showing someone using it for a few weeks and explaining why bisglycinate alone is enough, so I do not feel I am missing out on the other forms.
